subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this six-event AI-safety taxonomy as a versioned core and Plugin SDK contract, and if so should it extend the existing diagnostics-stability pipeline with SQLite retention rather than introduce a parallel store?
rationale: The answer fixes the permanent public API, security assertions, redaction policy, persistence owner, and plugin trust boundary across four dependent PRs; automation cannot safely select those contracts.

options.title: Consolidate before merge
options.body: Pause the series and redesign it around the existing sanitized diagnostics pipeline, SQLite persistence, canonical descriptors, and one versioned taxonomy contract.

options.title: Sponsor the proposed contract
options.body: Explicitly approve the new taxonomy and plugin-facing surface, then require the branch to add durability, bounded disclosure, compatibility documentation, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the core feature
options.body: Close or defer the series and retain the existing diagnostics and external telemetry surfaces until a narrower operator need and owner-backed design are established.

recommendation.title: Consolidate before merge
recommendation.body: Pause the series and redesign it around the existing sanitized diagnostics pipeline, SQLite persistence, canonical descriptors, and one versioned taxonomy contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans repository product direction, core-versus-plugin scope, public contracts, persistence, and security policy.
